rigs.comment: Derived by pnpm assets:verify-rig from the reference skeleton (joint list, parents, lengthAxis by majority vote x=2 y=59 z=3) and the representative file of each skeleton group (rest poses). INFERRED (M1 spike, not yet reviewed by a human): anatomyBones follow the table in spec 002 REQ-ANA-001 with the real joint names (note the head joint is 'Head', capitalised, not 'head'); regionBones assign every joint to exactly one body region (clavicles to torso, root to pelvis, fingers and leaf joints to hands/feet, hair has no bones because hair parts are separate head-bound meshes). Edit by hand; verify-rig only validates it.
